structural_constraints: decision must use one value from allowed_values.decision.
decision_rationale must be a non-empty string.
For accept, split, and reject, decision_evidence_refs must not be empty.
Every Pattern ID must exist in the input Candidate Manifest.
Every evidence reference must resolve to a provided Pattern field.
Every proposed Family canonical_name must use lowercase snake_case.
Every proposed Family must contain at least two members from at least two distinct primary APIs and at least two independent Report or Issue sources.
A Pattern ID must not appear more than once in the same proposed Family.
For accept and split, every input Pattern must appear in at least one proposed Family or in excluded_patterns.
For reject, every input Pattern must appear in excluded_patterns.
A Pattern assigned to a proposed Family must not also appear in excluded_patterns.
For split, the same Pattern may appear in multiple proposed Families.
Every Family member must contain a non-empty membership_rationale.
Every Family member must contain at least one evidence reference.
Every proposed Family must contain a non-empty family_core.statement.
Every proposed Family family_core.basis_types must contain at least one allowed value.
Every proposed Family family_core.evidence_refs must not be empty.
Every supporting_pattern_ids value must identify a member of the corresponding proposed Family.
Every affected_pattern_ids value must identify a member of the corresponding proposed Family.
Every proposed Family must contain a lineage object.
Every proposed Family lineage.action must use one value from allowed_values.lineage_action.
Every proposed Family lineage.rationale must be a non-empty string.
For create_new, target_family_id must be null and parent_family_ids must be empty.
For reuse_existing and update_existing, target_family_id must identify one provided existing Family and parent_family_ids must be empty.
For derive_new, target_family_id must be null and parent_family_ids must contain at least one provided existing Family ID.
For merge_existing, target_family_id must be null and parent_family_ids must contain at least two distinct provided existing Family IDs.
For split_existing, target_family_id must be null and parent_family_ids must contain exactly one provided existing Family ID.
A parent_family_ids array must not contain duplicate Family IDs.
If split_existing is used, the top-level decision must be split and at least two proposed Families must reference the same single parent Family with split_existing.
Every lineage Family ID must identify an existing Family explicitly provided in the current analysis input.
Every proposed Family must assign membership, commonality, applicability, and generalization confidence.
All evidence_status, confidence, basis type, condition kind, difference, conflict, and lineage-action values must use allowed_values.
Empty strings are not allowed.
